primary_endpoint: Percentage change in hepatic fat and number of participants with no conversion of [13C] cortisone to [13C] cortisol, from baseline to approximately 12 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: At approximately 12 weeks, percentage change in liver fat fraction was -0.667 with AZ compound and 0.139 with placebo; no conversion was reported in 42 participants on AZ compound and 0 on placebo. Statistical significance was not reported.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: 0/46 with AZ compound and 0/47 with placebo; no deaths in either group.
